title: identity.json — bundle patch identity
description: Bundle patch identity written by fetch/fetch-local beside the diff: the stable diff id (git patch-id --stable, labeled diff-sha256 fallback) with the head/base SHAs it was computed at. A patch id is a dedupe key, never an authorization token.

patch_id.description: Stable patch id, or null for an empty diff; a fallback id never matches a git-patch-id value.

patch_id_kind.description: Patch id algorithm: git-patch-id, the labeled diff-sha256 fallback, or none for an empty diff.

diff_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bundle full.diff (the filtered store hash).

raw_diff_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the identity input (full.raw.diff when present, else full.diff).

head_sha.description: Bundle head SHA the diff was computed at.

base_sha.description: Bundle base SHA the diff was computed at.
